numerical_failure.observed_behavior: With smoothing s greater than zero on large grids (e.g. shape 1000x1700 integer data), the fitted spline evaluates to NaN everywhere even though the input contains no NaN; no warning or error is raised, and the failure is irregular across runs.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The spline should evaluate to finite values (no NaN) for smoothing s values other than zero on large arrays, as it does on small grids.
trigger_conditions: smoothing parameter s set to a non-zero value (e.g. s=1)
large grid such as nx=1000, ny=1700 (smaller grids work)
input data is integer or float dtype with no NaN values
failure occurs irregularly, suspected related to memory allocation
